source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Set date / time by manually choose a random time.
Check date / time after setup successfully.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Date / time should change successfully.
2. Date / time should be displayed correctly as setting.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: BMC web login (operator) for the UI + ipmitool to verify
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Set date / time - WebUI: set date/time in BMC web -> Settings -> Date and Time. The web-UI setting is operator/agent-UI; agent verifies the applied BMC time with ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" sel time get 2>&1; ipmitool mc time get 2>&1.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the BMC SEL/MC time readback so the user confirms the web-set date/time applied correctly.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: changing BMC time affects all time-stamped logs; do it per the project clock.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly replaces random time with a controlled timestamp and requires WebUI audit evidence, multi-surface normalized readback, NTP policy and preserved event boundaries. V3.1 additionally requires the source WebUI control itself to remain covered even if API/IPMI aids readback.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 917/2291 accepts the prose/commands conditionally but gives no target-clock model, WebUI save-state proof, time-sensitive impact check, trusted reference, settling interval or recovery from a wrong timestamp.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: The preceding IPMI case has a separate SEL-clock conflict and cannot prove WebUI control. The following DST case changes offset/rules rather than an absolute timestamp.

historical_reviews.v3: No V3 overlay exists for this exact case.

original_test_intent: Verify the BMC WebUI date/time control accepts one controlled Project-approved timestamp, displays the saved timezone-normalized value correctly and remains consistent with the intended BMC/SEL/API clock surfaces under the approved time-sync policy.
original_method: Capture all relevant pre-change clocks and event boundaries, identify the WebUI page's clock/timezone/NTP semantics, save one explicit approved timestamp through that page, record the UI/audit acknowledgement, compare WebUI and authoritative raw readbacks to a trusted reference within tolerance, observe synchronization behavior and restore only the approved policy without clearing logs.
manual_activity: An engineer approves the controlled timestamp, timezone/NTP behavior and time-sensitive impact. A human operates and visually confirms the source WebUI page/save state. Automation may collect independent readbacks and normalized offsets, but cannot choose a random time, bypass the UI while claiming its coverage or issue the verdict.
required_inputs: BMC identity/firmware/WebUI version, authorized account and page/control mapping
Authoritative target clock and documented relationship among WebUI, BMC/API, SEL, RTC and host
Explicit approved timestamp, timezone/DST, independent trusted reference, tolerance and settling interval
NTP/PTP source/state and whether it must remain enabled, be isolated or be restored
Impact approval for certificates, authentication tokens, scheduled actions, power policy, clustering and audit
Protected supported raw readback path plus pre/post SEL/audit event-boundary plan
Wrong-clock/timezone recovery and final policy expectation
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, audit or host logs; preserve timestamped boundaries before and after the UI save.
Do not use a random time. Confirm the exact target, timestamp, timezone, NTP policy and tolerance before the state-changing save.
Do not expose credentials or assume `ipmitool mc time get` is supported; validate protected remote readbacks and their clock semantics.
Check certificates, tokens, schedules and power automation for backward/forward time-jump impact before changing the value.
Capture the WebUI field values, save result and audit event; a separate API/IPMI write cannot substitute for the source UI control.
Stop on unsaved state, wrong clock/timezone, unexpected NTP overwrite or cross-surface mismatch; preserve evidence and restore only via the approved policy without retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target, WebUI clock semantics, explicit timestamp/timezone/NTP/tolerance, impact, raw readbacks and restoration; present the save for human confirmation.
Capture pre-change WebUI, BMC/API, SEL and trusted-reference values plus event boundaries without clearing logs.
After human saves once, capture UI/audit acknowledgement, collect immediate and settled normalized readbacks and record synchronization behavior.
Restore only approved policy and stop without random time, exposed credentials, substitute UI write, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve WebUI clock ownership, timestamp, timezone/tolerance, NTP behavior and time-sensitive impact/recovery.
Perform or supervise the source WebUI save and visual display checkpoint.
Review UI/audit plus normalized raw/time-boundary evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its hybrid concept fits, but the proposed readbacks are unverified and target-inconsistent, while random time, UI clock semantics, NTP and timezone are unresolved. Readback cannot substitute for the source WebUI write/display.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the verified WebUI page to save one explicit approved timestamp. Use only platform-supported protected remote IPMI/API reads for corroboration, with all values normalized to the approved timezone/reference.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The manual random-time wording, WebUI date/time purpose, two display/change Criteria, no Script, DeepSeek readback/risk and 10/5-minute estimates remain preserved; Review corrects random selection only in the recommendation layer.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use one controlled WebUI save with complete pre/post clock, audit, timezone/NTP and trusted-reference comparison, then verify settling and restore the approved policy.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected BMC firmware/WebUI and documented time architecture with protected corroborating readback.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware/WebUI/API/IPMI versions, timezone database and NTP/PTP service/configuration.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: BMC vendor WebUI time/NTP specification, Project clock/timezone policy, time-sensitive service requirements and recovery SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces unsafe randomness with a deterministic approved timestamp and adds clock identity, audit, tolerance, synchronization and recovery while retaining WebUI coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: IPMI/API readback corroborates but does not prove the WebUI save/display path; a UI screenshot alone does not prove the underlying clock or NTP persistence.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Clock semantics, timestamp/timezone/tolerance, NTP policy, impact, readbacks and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Time jumps can reorder logs, invalidate authentication/certificates or trigger schedules, and NTP may immediately mask the manual setting.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use UI automation or an approved browser harness, but must preserve actual WebUI field/save/display coverage and human confirmation where rendering matters. An API/IPMI-only override must record the uncovered UI coverage and cannot claim this case passed solely from raw readback.
expected_evidence: Target/firmware/WebUI/account identity, clock architecture, approved timestamp/reference/timezone/tolerance/NTP policy and time-sensitive impact approval
Pre-change WebUI fields, BMC/API/SEL raw times and recent unmodified event boundaries with normalized offsets
WebUI interaction/save screenshot or DOM/audit evidence naming the requested value and displayed timezone
Immediate and settled multi-surface readbacks, NTP behavior, drift/tolerance and first post-change SEL/audit entries
Restored/retained policy, no log clear or retry, explicit WebUI coverage and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, Procedure and Criteria consistently target manual WebUI date/time change and display. `Random time` is unsafe and clock details are underdefined, but the core control path and purpose are not contradictory; Project inputs can supply deterministic values and semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The WebUI time-setting purpose is clear. Platform/Project inputs can define the clock, timestamp, timezone, tolerance, NTP and recovery, so execution is readiness pending rather than permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps PACKAGE but removes random time and unverified/two-target readbacks, protects credentials and requires clock-aware UI evidence and recovery.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on hybrid controls and strengthens source WebUI coverage, supported raw interface validation and deterministic restoration.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces generic conditional execution with auditable WebUI save plus normalized multi-surface evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps IPMI clock-target conflict and DST rule testing separate from this absolute WebUI setting path.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No invalid draft exists for this exact source identity.

review_improvement: Prevents an arbitrary time jump or unsupported raw command from being reported as a valid WebUI clock test, while retaining the source UI action and making its display and underlying clock effects independently measurable.
independent_technical_reasoning: A WebUI can display localized time while storing UTC, and a successful save may be rejected or quickly overwritten by synchronization. Conversely, an IPMI/SEL read may expose a different clock. Valid evidence must therefore bind the actual UI save and its audit event to an explicit timestamp, normalize all surfaces and observe settling under the chosen NTP policy rather than accepting randomness or one immediate string.
